question: Which chapter concludes the dialogue of Hara and Pārvatī in the Bhūtaśuddhi Tantra?
premises: The text is the revered Bhūtaśuddhi Tantra
The teaching is framed as a dialogue between Hara and Pārvatī

inference: The thirteenth chapter of the Bhūtaśuddhi Tantra concludes this portion of the Hara-Pārvatī dialogue.
